_notes.vin_structure: 17 chars: pos1-3=WMI, pos4-8=VDS, pos9=check_digit, pos10=model_year, pos11=plant, pos12-17=serial
_notes.how_to_use: 1) Decode pos10 using model_year_codes. 2) Find year_range matching that year. 3) Look up pos4-pos8 tables inside that era block. Different eras use positions DIFFERENTLY — always check era first.
_notes.excluded: Pre-1996 (1981-1995) excluded — model years not in active 30-year VIN cycle

position_9._note: Check digit. Values 0-9 or X. Mandatory in USA/Canada per 49 CFR Part 565. Calculated via NHTSA weighted formula from all other VIN positions.

position_11_plant._note: Assembly plant code. Numeric 0-9 = Japan. Letters = specific plants worldwide.
position_11_plant.A: Motomachi plant, Toyota City, Japan / Onnaing-Valenciennes, France (TMMF) [Yaris '14-'19]
position_11_plant.J: Takaoka plant, Toyota City, Japan / Vigo, Spain (ProAce City)
position_11_plant.L: Miyagi plant, Ohira, Japan (Toyota Motor East Japan)
position_11_plant.M: Tijuana, Baja CA, Mexico (TMMBC) / Atessa, Italy (ProAce Max diesel)
position_11_plant.R: Lafayette, IN, USA (Subaru of Indiana) [Camry '07-'16] / Adapazari, Turkey (TMMT) [C-HR '18-'22]
position_11_plant.W: Woodstock, ON, Canada (TMMC) / Graz, Austria (Magna Steyr) [GR Supra '20-]
position_11_plant.X: San Antonio, TX, USA (TMMTX) / Altona, Victoria, Australia

position_12_to_17._note: Sequential production serial number. 6 digits unique per plant/model year. Last 4 must be numeric per ISO 3779.

era_2010_present._note: Use for model years 2010+ (pos10 codes A through T and beyond). Toyota VIN format for North America from 2010 onward.
